welcome_private: 🌍 Welcome to GeoGuru & GeoGuessr Bot! I am the ultimate geography trivia bot designed for fun and competition in groups and solo! 🎮 Game Features: • 🏳️ Flag Quiz: Guess countries by their flags • 🏛 Capitals: Test your knowledge of world capitals • 📸 GeoGuessr: Guess countries by famous landmarks and street sights • 📊 Higher or Lower: Compare countries by population and area • 🛡 Coat of Arms: Identify sovereign emblems • 🎲 Mix Mode: Non-stop random challenges! 👥 Add me to your group chat to compete with friends, or play solo right here! Use the buttons below to start playing or explore commands.
welcome_group: 🌍 GeoGuru & GeoGuessr Bot is ready in this group! Compete with your group members in exciting geography challenges. Type /game to launch a match, or use /help to see all features!
help_text: 📖 GeoGuru & GeoGuessr Bot Guide Group Commands: • /game — Start a new interactive game match • /stop — Abort the currently active game • /top — Show this group's top players • /duel [@user] — Challenge a member to a 1v1 duel Solo & General Commands: • /solo — Play solo practice mode (with 3 lives) • /daily — Play today's Daily Geography Challenge • /profile — View your level, XP, stats, and achievements • /leaderboard — View global top players • /language — Change language (English / Русский / O'zbek) • /help — Show this help message How Scoring Works: • Correct answer: +100 pts + speed bonus • Wrong answer: -20 pts • Faster answers earn higher points!
